spec.name: A
spec.query: ((count by (namespace, label_resource_name) ( (kube_pod_created{namespace="<NAMESPACE>", pod=~"(bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers)-.*"} >= (time() - 3600)) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{namespace="<NAMESPACE>", label_resource_name=~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers"} )) * on(namespace) group_left(refold_version) label_replace(max by (namespace,image_spec)(kube_pod_container_info{container="cobalt-frontend"}),"refold_version","$1","image_spec",".*:v?(.*)")) or ((count by (namespace, label_resource_name) ( (kube_pod_created{namespace="<NAMESPACE>", pod=~"(bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers)-.*"} >= (time() - 3600)) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{namespace="<NAMESPACE>", label_resource_name=~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers"} )) unless on(namespace) label_replace(max by (namespace,image_spec)(kube_pod_container_info{container="cobalt-frontend"}),"refold_version","$1","image_spec",".*:v?(.*)"))

annotations.description: >8 {{ $labels.label_resource_name }} pods were created in the last hour — sustained recreation/crashloop (normal = replica count + one rollout). Threshold tunable.
annotations.resolution: 1) kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} get pods -l app={{ $labels.label_resource_name }} --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp  2) kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} describe pod <newest> (events: liveness/OOM/FailedScheduling)  3) common causes: app health/DB timeouts, OOM (raise limits), or cluster capacity (Insufficient cpu/mem).
